thread:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026.03.15-rc42 started for svc-embed-eu. Rolling to 10% traffic now, health checks on.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC95321 triggered — svc-embed-eu error-rate > 5% and p95 latency > 2s. https://pd.internal/INC95321

maria: ack @incident-bot — I'm oncall, looking. tagging @alex for eng assist.

alex: saw spike in traces around 09:23 UTC, 5xxs are mostly from model-worker-rc42 -> quant kernel. p95 jumped to ~5s for embed endpoints.

maria: CS pinged that EU customers are getting upload failures. CS-ops, confirm customer impact?

cs-ops: support: Confirmed — 3 enterprise accounts reporting failed embedding uploads starting 09:22 UTC. Ticket numbers open.

maria: ok, action: pause canary traffic to 0% and prepare rollback. @jen please stand by to execute rollback if traffic dimmer doesn't help.

jen: doing toggle now —

```
# set canary dimmer to 0
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags/svc-embed-canary-rc42 -d '{"enabled":false}'
kubectl -n prod-eu rollout undo deployment/svc-embed --to-revision=stable
```

deploy-bot: Canary dimmer set to 0% for svc-embed-eu by maria (web-console).

suresh: digging through logs — seeing repeated OOMs and `SIGABRT` from `quant-kernel.so` in model-worker-rc42. seq_len ~2048 requests correlate with failures. snippet:
```
E0315 09:23:14.512 model-worker[pid=1234] quant_kernel.cc:412] kernel_alloc failed: oom
*** Aborted at 1615892594 (unix time) ***
```

maria: rolling back now. initiating `kubectl rollout undo` for svc-embed in prod-eu. notifying PD.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC95321 acknowledged by maria — escalation paused.

maria: handing over to @alex — I have a calendar meeting in 10m but will watch for final status.

alex: taking over. running smoke tests against stable after rollback.

alex: smoke tests: `curl -sS https://svc-embed-eu/api/v1/health` -> OK. p99 latency back to baseline (~120ms). checking customer tickets.

cs-ops: support: Customer reports decreasing errors, will update tickets and keep monitoring for 1 hour.

maria: prelim root cause: quantized kernel regression introduced in rc42 when sequence length > 1024. Next steps: revert canary, tag failing build, remove default quantization path for now, create postmortem.

jen: created rollback PR and a hotfix branch to disable the new quant path by default. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pull/789 — will merge after CI.

alex: closing incident in PD as mitigated. pagerduty-bot: resolve INC95321 (mitigated by rollback).

incident-bot: Incident INC95321 marked mitigated. Postmortem owner: suresh. Follow-ups: assign action items (tag: postmortem, owner: suresh), schedule canary test with long-seq workloads, add smoke test for quant OOM.

maria: thanks all — handoff to next oncall if anything else pops, but for now stable is healthy. :white_check_mark:
